mapper.sql: id, stat_date, campaign_id, budget_cents, impressions, clicks, charge_cents, rejected_cents, rejected_count, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into ad_daily_stat (stat_date, campaign_id, budget_cents) values (#{statDate}, #{campaignId}, #{budgetCents}) on duplicate key update id = id
mapper.update: update ad_daily_stat set impressions = impressions + #{impressions}, clicks = clicks + #{clicks}, rejected_cents = rejected_cents + #{amountCents}, rejected_count = rejected_count + 1 where stat_date = #{statDate} and campaign_id = #{campaignId}
